title: Especialista em Plant Simulation (PJ)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation .
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk .
  • Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída).
  • Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos).

O que vai te destacar (Diferencial):

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter).
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL).
  • Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais).


Contratação: PJ.

title: Especialista em Plant Simulation (PJ)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.

title: BitMart Card Growth Specialist
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Collect and organize user payment needs and pain points in LATAM (especially Brazil and Argentina), and support execution of localized growth strategies and GTM plans for card business.
  • Work closely with product teams to translate customer needs into actionable feature improvements, enhancing user experience and transaction success rates.
  • Drive growth in card transactions and contribute to achieving key regional KPIs (GMV, active cards, transaction frequency).
  • Track payment regulations, crypto policies, and industry trends across LATAM, providing insights for compliance and strategy.
  • Lead partner/agent expansion for card business, ensuring smooth execution from signing to launch, improving retention, and supporting AMA and user growth activities.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Economics, Business, or related fields.
  • 1–3 years of BD/partnership experience, with at least 2 years in payments, card business, or fintech.
  • Experience in card products (virtual/physical) or payment rails; familiarity with Visa/Mastercard ecosystem.
  • Strong negotiation skills, able to manage the full BD cycle independently.
  • Fluency in Portuguese or Spanish, plus working-level English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in crypto, stablecoins, or blockchain.
  • Familiarity with LATAM markets (especially Brazil and Argentina).
  • Experience or network with local issuers (e.g., Yellow Card, Lemon Cash, Kolo Card).
  • Ability to cover both Portuguese and Spanish markets.

title: Analista de Gestão de Identidade Pleno
description:
Sobre a vaga

Analista de Gestão de Identidade com foco em Sailpoint para integrar nosso time de Segurança da Informação. O profissional será responsável pela sustentação, operação e evolução da plataforma Sailpoint ISC ou IdentityIQ, atuando diretamente na gestão do ciclo de vida de identidades, governança de acessos e automação de processos de provisionamento.

  • Administrar e evoluir a plataforma Sailpoint (ISC ou IdentityIQ);

  • Apoiar processos de auditoria e conformidade regulatória (LGPD, ISO, etc.).

  • Experiência com integração de sistemas, API ou banco de dados;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e troubleshooting técnico;

  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

title: Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar
description:
Quem somos

A Valuement , parte do Grupo Mantu , é uma consultoria internacional especialista em Source to Pay. Atuamos com clientes globais , ajudando a aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e melhorar a performance em contas a pagar, gestão de fornecedores e processos financeiros internos.

O Grupo Mantu , fundado em 2007, possui mais de 12.000 profissionais em 60 países, com faturamento anual de aproximadamente 1 bilhão de euros. Com expertise em transformação empresarial, tecnologia, marketing digital e gestão de talentos, o grupo oferece soluções estratégicas e inovadoras para clientes em diversos setores e regiões do mundo.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar para atuar diretamente com nossos clientes globais , identificando oportunidades de otimização, eficiência e melhoria de processos financeiros .


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Analisar e monitorar processos de contas a pagar dos clientes, identificando inconsistências, duplicidades e oportunidades de economia
  • Colaborar com equipes de Procurement e Financeiro dos clientes para otimização de pagamentos e contratos
  • Desenvolver KPIs e dashboards para acompanhamento da performance financeira
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos
  • Atuar como elo entre o cliente, fornecedores e stakeholders internos da Valuement


Seu perfil

  • Experiência comprovada em contas a pagar, tesouraria ou controladoria
  • Domínio avançado de sistemas ERP (SAP, Totvs, Oracle, etc.)
  • Excel avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, relatórios)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes
  • Excelente comunicação para interações com clientes, fornecedores e áreas internas
  • Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de influenciar stakeholders
  • Fluência em português; inglês é diferencial
  • Experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos financeiros e otimização de fluxos


O que oferecemos

  • Uma comunidade global com mais de 110 nacionalidades
  • Uma cultura baseada em confiança , onde 70% dos líderes-chave começaram em cargos de entrada
  • Um forte sistema de aprendizado com nossa Academia interna e mais de 250 módulos de treinamento
  • Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com encontros informais, atividades de team-building e eventos sociais
  • Compromisso sólido com Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR) , especialmente por meio do programa WeCare Together


Se você é um profissional entusiasmado, focado em gerar impacto e deseja se juntar a uma equipe dinâmica e em rápido crescimento, adoraríamos receber sua candidatura!

title: Analista de Integrações Digibee
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores.

28 anos de história e 16x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW).

Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência em Digibee , com atuação focada em orquestração de pipelines, visão funcional da jornada de integração e suporte técnico (N1 e N2) .


✅ Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com Digibee (orquestração e pipelines).
  • Atuação em suporte técnico N1 e N2 em ambientes de integração.
  • Capacidade analítica para entendimento funcional dos fluxos, não apenas desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com diagnóstico de incidentes, troubleshooting e causa raiz.
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos, com participação em salas de crise.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times técnicos, funcionais e fornecedor.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na orquestração da plataforma Digibee, garantindo a operação e aderência aos padrões da ferramenta.
  • Ter visão analítica e funcional dos pipelines, indo além do desenvolvimento, entendendo a jornada ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em suporte nível 1 e nível 2, incluindo:
  • Análise e investigação de incidentes (troubleshooting).
  • Diagnóstico e resolução de causa raiz.
  • Encerramento de chamados e abertura/redirecionamento para outras filas ou para o fabricante, quando necessário.
  • Participar de reuniões, calls e salas de crise (Incidentes, Problemas, Mudanças, Infraestrutura, Redes, etc.).
  • Atuar nos chamados de rotina da plataforma.
  • Contribuir para a construção da base de Erros Conhecidos e Base de Conhecimento.
  • Criar e/ou atuar junto ao cliente na construção de monitoramentos.
  • Realizar desenvolvimentos para correção de incidentes e demandas de pequeno porte.

title: Supervisor(a) de vendas - Cachoeirinha (RS)
description:
Descrição da vaga

NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.

Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.

E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • O Supervisor de Vendas realizará a gestão dos consultores da loja: acompanhar as vendas, dar suporte, contribuir com o desenvolvimento da equipe e garantir a entrega dos resultados;
  • Responsável por todos os processos administrativos da equipe;
  • Desenvolvimento e acompanhamento das estratégias comerciais;
  • Vendas de produtos financeiros e acionamentos junto à equipe;
  • Divulgação dos produtos;
  • Responsável pela abertura e fechamento da loja.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Necessário que o Supervisor de Vendas possua experiência com gestão de equipe de vendas de qualquer produto;
  • Necessário ter experiência com vendas e trabalhado com metas;
  • Desejável atuação com vendas de multiprodutos e experiências com vendas ativas por telefone e presenciais;
  • Perfil do Supervisor de Vendas: Proativo, resiliente, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, senso de urgência, foco no cliente e nos resultados de vendas.
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.


Informações adicionais

Remuneração


Salário Fixo + Remuneração Variável + Bônus


Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:


  • Plano de saúde após 90 dias com coparticipação de 30% em consultas e exames simples Telemedicina;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • help investe em você - plataforma educacional com + de 60 instituições de ensino;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Salário fixo + Comissão;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Parceria Gympass;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Psicologia Viva - Sessões de terapia online gratuita;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.


Horário de trabalho do Supervisor de Vendas (vaga presencial):

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h


E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

title: Data Analyst
description:
Role: Data Analyst

Contract Duration: 7 months

Work Type: Remote

Location: Colombia

Rate: 5,000,000 Colombian pesos per month


We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support business performance analysis and strategic decision-making. This role works closely with business, finance, and operations teams to analyze performance data, identify trends, and deliver insights that drive business decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business and operational data to identify performance trends and improvement opportunities
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports to track KPIs and business performance
  • Conduct deep-dive and ad hoc analyses to explain trends and business drivers
  • Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven decisions


Required Experience

  • Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or related quantitative field
  • 5+ years experience in Data Analysis or Business Analytics
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience with Python (or similar analytical language)
  • Experience building dashboards using Power BI or similar BI tools
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with business or financial performance analytics (Preferred)
  • Experience with AWS or cloud data environments (Preferred)
  • Exposure to Spark / PySpark (Preferred)
  • Experience with data pipelines or orchestration tools (Preferred)

title: Sourcer Júnior/Pleno - BR
description:
Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de Sourcer Júnior/Pleno para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação na AI/R Company, empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.



Você será responsável por:


  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.



O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
The Role

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are self-funded, profitable, and moving fast, which means the people here are not here to coast. Everyone on this team has a goal they are building toward and puts in the work to get there. If you are looking for a place where your effort directly shapes company growth and your own earnings, this is it.


We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.


You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. Prospecting and sourcing are handled upstream. Your job is to convert.

What you'll do

  • Work exclusively with warm, SDR-qualified and inbound leads. You are not cold calling. You are closing.
  • Run structured discovery calls that uncover real pain, not surface-level answers
  • Deliver demos tailored to what you learned in discovery, not a canned deck
  • Own the full sales cycle from first call to signed contract
  • Keep every open opportunity engaged with timely, relevant follow-up
  • Send clear, concise follow-up emails after every call the same day
  • Maintain clean, accurate pipeline records in CRM at all times
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure tight handoffs and fast response on warm leads
  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets consistently
  • Feed insights back into messaging, objection handling, and playbooks


Additional Requirements

  • 3+ years of closing experience in a B2B SaaS AE role
  • A track record of consistently exceeding quota. We will ask about this specifically. If attainment has been a struggle at any point, this is not the right fit
  • Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it
  • Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks
  • Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates
  • Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about
  • Self-managed. You own your pipeline and your outcomes without needing a manager to push you
  • Resilient and persistent without being annoying. You know the difference between a dead deal and a deal that needs one more touch


Mandatory Skills

Sales

English Communication


Good-to-have Skills

HubSpot

title: Atlassian Consultant | Customer Facing Technical Expert
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we specialize in transforming teamwork through tailored solutions for Atlassian products. Our global team of experts in DevOps, ITSM, and agile methodologies delivers innovative services, including AI-driven integrations, managed licensing, and consulting. Trusted by over 1,000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we provide comprehensive support, from Jira and Confluence training to Asset Management in JSM. Join us in reshaping the future of collaboration and technology-enabled teamwork.


Role Description

This is a full-time hybrid role for an Atlassian Customer Facing Technical Expert, based in the Greater São Paulo Area with some flexibility for remote work. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and resolving technical inquiries related to Atlassian products. You will also assist with analyzing client challenges, recommending tailored solutions, and providing training on Atlassian tools and best practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with a focus on delivering excellent service and building client relationships
  • Effective Communication and Interpersonal skills for working with diverse stakeholders
  • Analytical Skills to assess client needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend solutions
  • Experience with Atlassian tools (such as Jira, Confluence, and JSM) and a deep understanding of their applications
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment, balancing onsite and remote work
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role and fluency in Portuguese and English are highly beneficial

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities

• Definir e garantir padrões de design e boas práticas de codificação;

• Domínio profundo em Java 11+ e frameworks relacionados (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud);

• Sólida experiência com arquiteturas baseadas em microserviços e integração via APIs (REST, gRPC, SOAP);

• Conhecimento em sistemas financeiros e bancários (Matera, SPB, SELIC, B3/CETIP, SAP);

• Experiência em infraestrutura cloud (AWS: ECS, EKS, Lambda) e práticas modernas de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI);

• Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle) e NoSQL (Redis);

• Familiaridade com soluções de observabilidade e segurança (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, OAuth2, mTLS);

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Kotlin/AWS Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59460


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência com: Java, Kotlin, AWS (Lambda, Step Function, S3, Cloud Watch, Api Gateway, EC2, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, SNS), Kafka, Terraform, GITHUB, Datadog.
  • Desejável: Inteligência Artificial.
  • CLT pela BRQ, salário a combinar+ benefícios.
  • 100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD)
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.


We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Business Development Manager who will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships, and promoting our trading solutions across markets. This role requires strong knowledge of the online trading industry and the ability to convert opportunities into long-term business relationships.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, IBs, and affiliates
  • Identify client trading needs and propose suitable brokerage services, platforms, and solutions
  • Effectively communicate the company’s value proposition, trading conditions, platforms, and partnership programs
  • Research sales statistics and assess growth opportunities within target markets
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, partners, and clients within the CRM system
  • Coordinate with internal departments (Dealing, Compliance, Marketing, Support) to ensure high service standards and client satisfaction
  • Conduct presentations, webinars, and platform demonstrations to prospective clients and partners


Key Requirements


  • Proven experience in Business Development / Sales within a CFD / Forex Brokerage
  • Strong understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and brokerage operations
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage
  • Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities
  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, expos, and industry events


What We Offer


  • Competitive base salary & performance-based incentives and bonuses
  • Opportunity to influence regional partnership and client acquisition strategies
  • Career progression within a well-established Forex Brokerage environment
  • Exposure to global financial markets and advanced trading technologies
  • Flexible working arrangement


If you’re a results-driven business development professional with industry experience and a passion for building strong client and partner relationships, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.

title: CyberArk Engineer
description:
PAM Automation Engineer

Remote

6 months


Overview

The PAM Automation Engineer is responsible for building and improving automation tools to improve operation process used to manage ou PAM solution (mainly based on CyberArk PAM). He will bu , and maintaining Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, mainly using CyberArk PAM product. This role ensures that privileged accounts, credentials, and access pathways across the enterprise are secure, monitored, and compliant with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. The CyberArk Engineer partners closely with Security, Infrastructure, and Application teams to safeguard critical systems against unauthorized access.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).

3–7+ years experience in cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, or infrastructure security.

Hands?on experience with CyberArk Privileged Access Management suite (+ Credential providers).

Strong understanding of:

Identity & Access Management concepts

Windows & Linux administration

Active Directory & LDAP

Networking fundamentals

Secrets management

Experience with scripting languages (PowerShell, Python, Bash).

Experience with REST APIs and automation frameworks.

Experience with Ansible

Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) tools.

title: Consultor(a) de Vendas - Cachoeirinha (RS)
description:
Descrição da vaga

NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.


Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.


Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.


Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.


E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • O Consultor de Vendas irá realizar telemarketing ativo para prospecção de clientes;
  • O Consultor realizará vendas de produtos financeiros como: Crédito Consignado, Cartão de Crédito, Seguros, Crédito Pessoal, Antecipação de saque aniversário FGTS e outros.
  • Cadastrar as propostas no sistema e fechamento de contratos;
  • Atuar na retenção e fidelização de clientes.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Perfil do Consultor de Vendas: Proativo, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, foco no cliente e metas de vendas;
  • Desejável experiência com vendas e metas;
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.


Informações adicionais

Remuneração:


Salário Fixo + Remuneração Variável + Bônus Mensal


Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:


  • Plano de saúde após 90 dias com coparticipação de 30% em consultas e exames simples Telemedicina;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • help investe em você - plataforma educacional com + de 60 instituições de ensino;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Parceria Gympass;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Programas de qualidade de vida;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.


Horário de trabalho do Consultor de Vendas (vaga presencial):

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h



E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

title: Analista de Middleware Sênior (PJ)
description:
Atividades:

Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;

Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;

Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;

Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);

Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;

Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;

Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;

Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;

Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;

Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;

Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;

Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;

Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;

Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs;

Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;

Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR com executivos;

Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;

Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;

Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;

Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;

Experiência em camada de observabilidade;

Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;

Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Ordering e Integrações;

Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;

Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;

Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Seja um perfil de dinâmico, “falador”, que conduza os troubleshootings, que fale nas salas, se incomode com os problemas e busque alternativas para resolvê-los.

Experiência em ordering, gateway e facilidade de compreensão do end to end;

Operação em sistemas de integração;

Experiencia em implantação de Automações e IA efetivamente;

Experiência em empresas de Telecom;


Contratação: PJ.

Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;

Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;

Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;

Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);

Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;

Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;

Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;

Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;

Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;

Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;

Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;

Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;

Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;

Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs;

Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;

Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR com executivos;

Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;

Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;

Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;

Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;

Experiência em camada de observabilidade;

Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;

Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Ordering e Integrações;

Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;

Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;

Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Seja um perfil de dinâmico, “falador”, que conduza os troubleshootings, que fale nas salas, se incomode com os problemas e busque alternativas para resolvê-los.

Experiência em ordering, gateway e facilidade de compreensão do end to end;

Operação em sistemas de integração;

Experiencia em implantação de Automações e IA efetivamente;

Experiência em empresas de Telecom;


Contratação: PJ.

title: Data Analyst
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 13k-18k BRL/mo.


Must-Haves:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a data engineering/ analyst role
  • Experience with Python (ETL, transformations)
  • PySpark specifically (via Databricks)
  • Familiarity with pandas‑style transformations
  • Experience with SQL for database querying and management
  • Experience with Tableau
  • Strong visual storytelling
  • Ability to innovate and make dashboards genuinely usable


Nice-To-Haves:

  • Experience working with Databricks

Day to day:

A client of Insight Global is looking to hire a data analyst to join their team remotely in the LATAM region. This person will be responsible for partnering directly with business stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and deliver end to end data solutions. This person's main focus will be on enabling the business through clean data, strong analytics, and exceptional visualization. This person will not be maintaining existing pipelines, but building new ones to support the client's strategic initiatives.

Key responsibilities listed below:

  • Partner 1:1 with business stakeholders to:
  • Understand goals and initiatives
  • Define KPIs and success metrics
  • Perform end‑to‑end data work:
  • Identify and validate data sources
  • Transform data to align with business goals
  • Build net‑new ETL pipelines as needed
  • Develop dashboards and reporting in Tableau that:
  • Tell a clear story
  • Are visually polished and intuitive
  • Are suitable for senior leadership consumption
  • Create presentations and insights that support executive decision‑making
  • Operate in a project‑based environment with ownership from intake to delivery

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Power BI Developer (DAX + Azure)

Location

Remote (Brazil / Argentina – Nearshore)

Duration

6+ Months Contract (High likelihood of extension)

Start Date

Immediate / ASAP (Only candidates with short or no notice period)

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Power BI Developer with deep expertise in DAX, data modeling, and Azure-based data platforms . This role requires hands-on experience building scalable BI solutions, working with large datasets, and enabling business stakeholders to make data-driven decisions.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and optimize data models, dashboards, and analytics solutions in a modern cloud environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets
  • Build and optimize complex DAX measures and calculations
  • Develop robust data models (star schema, snowflake schema)
  • Work with Azure data services to ingest, transform, and model data
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and data integration workflows
  • Ensure performance tuning and optimization of BI solutions
  • Translate business requirements into scalable analytics solutions
  • Drive business adoption through impactful visualizations
  • Collaborate in an Agile environment

Must-Have Skills (Non-Negotiable)

Power BI & DAX

  • 5+ years of experience with Power BI
  • Strong expertise in DAX (advanced calculations, optimization)
  • Experience with Power BI datasets & semantic models
  • Strong data modeling experience

Azure (Critical)

  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Azure SQL
  • Azure Data Lake
  • Azure Synapse (preferred)
  • Experience building data pipelines in Azure

Data & Backend

  • Strong SQL expertise
  • Experience with data transformation and cleansing
  • Understanding of data warehouse architecture

Additional Technical Skills

  • Experience with Snowflake (strong plus)
  • Knowledge of Python for data processing (preferred)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, version control

Experience Level

  • 8–15+ years in BI / Data Engineering / Analytics

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) domain
  • Exposure to Supply Chain or Finance data
  • Experience with SSAS / OLAP cubes
  • Understanding of microservices / APIs

Ideal Candidate

  • Strong hands-on developer with deep DAX expertise
  • Solid experience working in Azure data ecosystem
  • Able to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment
  • Strong communicator with business-facing experience

title: Incident Manager
description:
Your role and Responsabilities:


  • Act as the single point of ownership for onboarding-related operational and stakeholder escalations
  • Perform root-cause analysis , identify risks, assess impact, and drive corrective and preventive actions
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth handoffs and service stability
  • Manage escalations end-to-end, ensuring closure within agreed SLAs
  • Prepare and share clear, structured status reports and stakeholder communications
  • Analyze complex data to support data-driven decisions and continuous process improvement


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Experience in project or operational support roles (IT preferred)
  • Advanced English
  • Hands-on experience supporting large-scale, complex environments
  • Strong expertise in risk identification, escalation handling, and mitigation planning
  • Experience with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira , or similar platforms
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving
  • Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word for reporting and documentation


Nice to have:


Familiar with SAP ATLAS tool.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Engineering Design Specialist
description:
Job Title: Engineering Design Specialist (Contract – Remote)

Location: Remote (Global) Permanent Remote Work

Contract Duration: 22 Weeks

Work Schedule: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: USD $15 – $35 per hour (based on experience)


About the Role

We are hiring experienced Engineering Design Specialists to work on advanced, simulation-based design challenges that support cutting-edge technology initiatives.

This is a unique opportunity to apply deep engineering expertise to create realistic, high-impact design problems involving real-world constraints, trade-offs, and system optimization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop simulation-based engineering problems with clear constraints and performance goals
  • Create detailed problem sets including solutions, edge cases, and variations
  • Validate engineering designs using physics-based simulation tools
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine and improve design challenges
  • Ensure accuracy across calculations, assumptions, and real-world feasibility


Domain Expertise (Any One or More)

  • Electrical / Electronics Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Control Systems
  • Civil / Structural Engineering
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Robotics / Mechatronics
  • Materials / Nano Engineering
  • Systems Engineering
  • Energy / Nuclear Engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Engineering or Applied Sciences
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience (not just analysis)
  • Experience working with simulation tools (open-source preferred)
  • Strong programming skills (Python or similar)
  • High attention to detail and strong problem-solving ability


Preferred Skills

  • Experience creating engineering problems, coursework, or technical assessments
  • Exposure to AI/ML, simulation workflows, or automation frameworks
  • Cross-domain engineering knowledge


Work Setup & Additional Information

  • Fully remote, contract-based opportunity
  • Full-time commitment preferred
  • Selection process includes assessment and interview rounds
  • Candidates should be available to start within short notice (Immediate – 15 days preferred)

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Immigration Paralegal (PORTUGUESE SPEAKER)
description:
Company Description

Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.


Role Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
  • Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
  • Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
  • Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
  • Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
  • Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
  • Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
  • Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
  • Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only

﻿

To Apply

  • To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to . Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Java/React)
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


What we'd like to see in a candidate:

  • Experience designing and building backend services using Java and the Spring Boot framework , with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design , distributed systems, and best practices for building secure and resilient backend architectures.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguous environments and deliver pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Availability to travel to Australia for an expected period of time of 2-3 months.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About the role:

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About the role:

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
Title: Java Lead Developer

Location: 100% Remote(Brazil)

Job Type: Contract


Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Lead Java Developer to architect, lead,

and deliver scalable microservice-based solutions in a cloud-native environment. This role

requires deep technical expertise, strong leadership, and a proven track record in

enterprise-scale systems—preferably within the telecommunications industry.


Key Responsibilities:

• Architect and lead the development of robust Java-based microservices using Spring

Boot and related frameworks.

• Guide and mentor engineering teams, fostering best practices in software design,

testing, and DevOps.

• Lead cloud-native solution design and deployment using AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker.

• Design and implement event-driven systems using Apache Kafka and messaging

frameworks like Apache Camel.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business goals

and customer needs.

• Drive modernization efforts, including monolith-to-microservices transformations and

legacy system integrations.

• Champion CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability practices.

• Lead initiatives in identity management, billing systems, and customer self-service

platforms.

• Ensure secure coding practices, performance optimization, and production readiness.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation and promote knowledge sharing across teams.


Required Qualifications:

• 8+ years of professional experience in Java development, including enterprise-scale

microservices.

• 5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), including architecture

and deployment.

• Proven experience with Spring Boot, GraphQL, and Node.js in backend development.

• Strong background in event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka,

Camel).

• Experience leading application modernization and digital transformation projects.

• Expertise in containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.

• Familiarity with service meshes (e.g., Istio), API gateways (e.g., Zuul, NGINX), and

OAuth2/SAML.

• Proficiency in CI/CD tools (GitLab, Jenkins), observability tools (DataDog, SumoLogic),

and distributed tracing.• Strong understanding of telecommunications systems, including identity, billing, and

device management.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Preferred Experience:

• Telecommunications industry experience, including work with customer identity,

billing systems, and network equipment management.

• Experience with full-stack development, including React or Angular for internal tooling.

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and SAFE frameworks.

• Cloud-native tool development and internal platform engineering.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)
description:
Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)

Replay API / LeetGaming.pro (Brazil-based, fully open-source core)


Role Summary

As a Backend Go Developer, you will design, build, and scale the core Go backend that powers LeetGaming.pro’s Replay API — the engine behind AI-driven game replay analysis, matchmaking, tournaments, and player performance evaluation for competitive titles (CS2, Valorant, and more). You will work directly on parsing massive volumes of replay files, storing and querying structured data, running background workers, and delivering secure, high-performance REST/RPC/WebSocket APIs that serve gamers, teams, and tournament organizers worldwide.


What Success Looks Like

  • You ship production-ready features (new game parsers, event handlers, scoring systems, or ML integrations) that are fast, reliable, and easy to maintain.
  • The platform scales smoothly as replay volume grows, with clean code, comprehensive tests, and zero-downtime deployments via Docker + Kubernetes.
  • You actively contribute to the open-source repository, improve architecture and security (including post-quantum cryptography), and help the team move from prototype to production launch.
  • Stakeholders (founders, esports partners, and players) see tangible improvements in data accuracy, query speed, and new capabilities like MMR wallets or AI talent scoring.


How This Role Fits into the Organization

Replay API is the central backend of LeetGaming.pro. Your work directly enables the entire product: every replay upload, match analysis, tournament bracket, and player insight flows through the services you build. You will collaborate closely with the small, high-impact team (currently led by the project’s main contributor) and influence the product roadmap while keeping the entire stack open-source under MIT.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, RPC endpoints, and secure WebSocket services in Go to handle replay ingestion, search, and real-time event streaming.
  • Develop and optimize replay parsers and background workers (OCR, oracle, game-discovery, etc.) that extract player actions, statistics, and events from multiple game formats.
  • Model, store, and query large-scale replay data using MongoDB with efficient indexing, aggregation pipelines, and the repository pattern.
  • Build and maintain matchmaking, tournament, MMR, and Solana wallet integration logic.
  • Integrate and expose machine-learning models that evaluate player performance and generate talent scores.
  • Ensure high availability and scalability by containerizing services with Docker and deploying on Kubernetes.
  • Write unit/integration tests, enforce code quality with golangci-lint, and participate in CI/CD pipelines that publish images to GitHub Container Registry.
  • Harden security (RID token auth, post-quantum cryptography, input validation) across all services.
  • Document APIs (OpenAPI) and contribute to architecture decisions and Jira backlog.
  • Collaborate with the open-source community by reviewing pull requests and following the project’s contributing guidelines.


Qualifications


Required

  • Strong proficiency in Go (1.16+; 1.23+ preferred) with experience building production backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB (or comparable NoSQL databases) and designing performant data models.
  • Solid understanding of REST, RPC, and WebSocket APIs.
  • Experience with Docker for containerization and basic Kubernetes deployment knowledge.
  • Comfortable writing tests and following clean-code practices (linting, modular architecture).


Preferred

  • Previous work with game replay parsing, binary data formats, or large-scale data processing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems, background workers, or microservices.
  • Exposure to machine-learning model integration or analytics platforms.
  • Interest or experience in esports, competitive gaming, matchmaking systems, or blockchain/Solana integrations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (not required).
  • Located in Brazil or available for overlapping hours with a Brazil-based team.


Nice-to-Have

  • Contributions to open-source Go projects.
  • Knowledge of post-quantum cryptography or advanced security practices.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jira, or similar tools used by the team.


What We Offer

  • Direct impact on an open-source product that is shaping the future of competitive gaming analytics.
  • Work alongside a small, passionate team that values quality code and rapid iteration.
  • Flexible remote setup with Brazil-friendly hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into senior/lead roles as the platform expands.

title: Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)
description:
Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)

Replay API / LeetGaming.pro (Brazil-based, fully open-source core)


Role Summary

As a Backend Go Developer, you will design, build, and scale the core Go backend that powers LeetGaming.pro’s Replay API — the engine behind AI-driven game replay analysis, matchmaking, tournaments, and player performance evaluation for competitive titles (CS2, Valorant, and more). You will work directly on parsing massive volumes of replay files, storing and querying structured data, running background workers, and delivering secure, high-performance REST/RPC/WebSocket APIs that serve gamers, teams, and tournament organizers worldwide.


What Success Looks Like

  • You ship production-ready features (new game parsers, event handlers, scoring systems, or ML integrations) that are fast, reliable, and easy to maintain.
  • The platform scales smoothly as replay volume grows, with clean code, comprehensive tests, and zero-downtime deployments via Docker + Kubernetes.
  • You actively contribute to the open-source repository, improve architecture and security (including post-quantum cryptography), and help the team move from prototype to production launch.
  • Stakeholders (founders, esports partners, and players) see tangible improvements in data accuracy, query speed, and new capabilities like MMR wallets or AI talent scoring.


How This Role Fits into the Organization

Replay API is the central backend of LeetGaming.pro. Your work directly enables the entire product: every replay upload, match analysis, tournament bracket, and player insight flows through the services you build. You will collaborate closely with the small, high-impact team (currently led by the project’s main contributor) and influence the product roadmap while keeping the entire stack open-source under MIT.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, RPC endpoints, and secure WebSocket services in Go to handle replay ingestion, search, and real-time event streaming.
  • Develop and optimize replay parsers and background workers (OCR, oracle, game-discovery, etc.) that extract player actions, statistics, and events from multiple game formats.
  • Model, store, and query large-scale replay data using MongoDB with efficient indexing, aggregation pipelines, and the repository pattern.
  • Build and maintain matchmaking, tournament, MMR, and Solana wallet integration logic.
  • Integrate and expose machine-learning models that evaluate player performance and generate talent scores.
  • Ensure high availability and scalability by containerizing services with Docker and deploying on Kubernetes.

Required

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.
